workflow_yaml:
name: CI

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  checks: write

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      APP_ENV: ci
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Build
        id: build
        run: ./gradlew --no-daemon clean build

      - name: Test
        run: ./gradlew --no-daemon test

      - name: Publish test results
        if: ${{ always() && steps.build.outcome == 'success' }}
        uses: dorny/test-reporter@v2
        with:
          name: JUnit test results
          path: build/test-results/test/*.xml
          reporter: java-junit
          fail-on-error: false
          fail-on-empty: true

      - name: Archive JARs
        if: ${{ always() }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: build-libs
          path: build/libs/*.jar
          if-no-files-found: error
assumptions: No triggers are specified, so workflow_dispatch is used as an evaluation-only assumption; it runs against the ref selected when dispatched.
Jenkins agent any is represented by ubuntu-latest. Its installed tooling, including Java, is not assumed to match the Jenkins agent; no JDK version is specified by the source.
The sequential stages run in one GitHub Actions job so they share a workspace. No cross-job artifact transfer is needed or assumed.

The JUnit reporter publishes GitHub check-run reporting rather than Jenkins' test-result UI. Its reporting step does not independently fail on reported test failures; the Gradle test command's exit status remains responsible for failing the job.
The reporter requires checks: write permission. Jenkins artifact fingerprinting has no direct equivalent in this workflow; the JARs are uploaded as a GitHub Actions artifact instead.

behavior_mapping.target: jobs.build-and-test.runs-on uses ubuntu-latest as a Linux runner assumption.
jobs.build-and-test.env.APP_ENV is set to ci for all steps.
Checkout step uses actions/checkout@v4 for the dispatch-selected ref.
Build step runs the same command before the Test step.
Test step runs the same command after Build; its nonzero exit fails the job.
Publish test results runs after the test attempt even if it fails, provided Build succeeded; it preserves the literal glob and fails if reports are missing.

behavior_mapping.source: Pipeline post always: archiveArtifacts artifacts: 'build/libs/*.jar', fingerprint: true
behavior_mapping.target: Archive JARs runs regardless of earlier step outcomes, preserves the literal glob, and fails if no files match. GitHub artifact upload replaces archiving; fingerprinting is unsupported.
